_about: Approved cast voices (27 Nov 2026). Each <name>.wav here is that character's fixed reference clip: Chatterbox copies it and acts every line. The Kokoro settings below rebuild the clips exactly if one is ever lost. Never change a voice without the user's approval.

engine.reference: kokoro-onnx 0.6.1, /root/voice/kokoro-v1.0.onnx + voices-v1.0.bin, lang en-gb, pitch shift with pedalboard PitchShift
engine.performer: chatterbox-tts 0.1.7 (ResembleAI/chatterbox) in /root/cb-venv, ChatterboxTTS.generate(text, audio_prompt_path=<name>.wav, exaggeration, cfg_weight)

narrator.role: the house voice (voice E): the explainer who gets interrupted
narrator.reference_text: Every week on this channel we take one ordinary bit of British money and ask what would happen if it went a different way. Prices, pay packets, the pound in your pocket. It's usually simpler than you'd think, and it's always stranger.

tested.line: If you paid a whole month's rent in one p coins, you might think your landlord had to take it, but you might be surprised to know that
Wait. Is he okay? That was not in the script.
Someone get him out of there! Now!

alfie.role: the lead, the viewer's stand-in: younger, slightly quick

tested.line: Hang on. Where's all the cash gone?
Yeah, but how? How does that even work, mate?

nan.role: tiny, stooped, remembers the old prices: older, slower

tested.line: Ooh, that's not what things cost in my day, love.

producer.role: the Booth's producer, mostly off-mic: quick, easily panicked (talkback filter on screen)

tested.line: Cut the music! Someone get him out of there!

cast_reference_text: Right, so here's the thing. Every week something in this country costs a bit more than it did, and nobody ever really tells you why. Prices go up, wages sort of follow, and somehow we all just carry on.
_note: alfie, mate, nan, producer and the guests were made from cast_reference_text (tools/make_voice.py); the narrator from its own reference_text.

shopkeeper.role: the corner-shop keeper: tall, lanky, deadpan

assistant.role: the electronics-shop sales assistant: tiny, bored
